Canvas and aspect ratio: Create a single 9:21 vertical image.

Reference image usage: Image 1 is the product identity reference. Infer the exact product appearance from Image 1 and keep the same product identity; do not redesign, invent, or over-describe the product from text.

Human reference usage: The Q-version 3D baker character should be a generic, friendly, stylized 3D cartoon character, not copying any specific brand mascot.

Overall visual system: Warm and healing 3D miniature baking world. Palette of warm caramel, rich chocolate brown, warm oat milk white, and light cocoa gold. Soft side-backlight and gentle volumetric light. Miniature 3D baking workshop space with depth of field, featuring floating chocolate chips and golden wheat ears. Materials show crispy porous cookie texture and semi-melted glossy chocolate chips.

Current viewport: Slice 01, establishing the product identity and core emotional appeal.

Module role: Hero module acting as the main visual hook.

Screen job and evidence: Introduce the product and its core benefit through a stunning hero visual and 3 key benefit tags.

Layout intent: Immersive full-bleed 3D scene with a floating central product and integrated floating labels.

Flexible page composition: High-impact, medium-density layout. A giant cookie based on Image 1 floats in the center as the primary visual focus. A small Q-version baker is positioned next to it. Three floating 3D-textured tags are placed below the cookie, integrated naturally into the environment.

Primary module: A giant crispy chocolate cookie based on the product from Image 1 floats in the center of a warm 3D miniature baking workshop. The cookie has a highly detailed, crispy, porous texture with semi-melted chocolate chips glistening under warm side-backlight. A cute, friendly Q-version 3D baker character stands next to the cookie, making a welcoming gesture.

Secondary modules: Three small, floating 3D-textured rounded tags with soft drop shadows float near the bottom, surrounded by floating chocolate chips and golden wheat ears.

Chinese typography: Use a rounded, friendly, modern Chinese sans-serif font style. Keep text clean and legible.

Edge safety: Keep the top 10% as a warm oat milk white transition zone. Keep the bottom 15% clear of text, filled with floating chocolate chips and golden wheat ears to guide the eye downward.

Composition notes: Centralized composition with dynamic depth of field. Warm, inviting lighting creates a soft glow around the cookie.

Important constraints: All visible text must be in Simplified Chinese. No English titles, no garbled text. Do not redesign the product from Image 1.

Canvas and aspect ratio: Create a single 9:21 vertical image.

Reference image usage: Image 1 is the product identity reference. Infer the exact product appearance from Image 1 and keep the same product identity; do not redesign, invent, or over-describe the product from text.

Overall visual system: Warm, healing, fairytale-like 3D miniature baking world. Palette of warm caramel, rich chocolate brown, warm oat milk white, and light cocoa gold. Warm soft side-backlight and soft volume light. 3D cartoon style.

Current viewport: Slice 03. Show the gold quality of selected raw ingredients and handmade baking feel to resolve concerns about cheap ingredients.

Module role: Function module with high information density, using a primary workshop scene and two secondary detail windows.

Screen job and evidence: Demonstrate raw material quality using a 3D miniature workshop scene combined with dual macro detail windows as evidence.

Layout intent: High-density page composition. 1 primary module (55% area) at the top/center, and 2 secondary detail windows (20% area each) arranged below.

Primary module: In a 3D miniature baking workshop, a cute Q-version 3D baker character is putting golden wheat ears and large chocolate blocks into a stone mill. Warm side-backlight illuminates floating oat milk white flour and cocoa powder particles in the air.

Secondary modules:
- Detail Window 1: A macro close-up of a plump imported cocoa bean surrounded by shiny, silky chocolate sauce.
- Detail Window 2: A macro close-up of a golden wheat ear surrounded by porous, fluffy wheat flour.

Chinese typography: Use rounded, friendly modern sans-serif Chinese font style, clean and stable stroke weights, maximum 3 levels of hierarchy, left-aligned or centered.

Reference image usage: Use Image 1 as the product identity reference; infer the exact product appearance from Image 1 and keep the same product identity; do not redesign, invent, or over-describe the product from text.

Overall visual system: A warm, healing, and whimsical 3D miniature baking world. The color palette consists of warm caramel, rich chocolate brown, warm oat-milk white, and light cocoa gold. Illuminated by warm, soft side-backlight that creates glowing edge highlights and volumetric light. The background is a 3D cartoon-style baking workshop with depth-of-field blurred floating chocolate chips and golden wheat ears.

Current viewport: Slice 05. A high-density detail showcase focusing on the baking quality and the crispy, porous texture of the cookie.

Layout intent: A central primary visual featuring a split cookie cutaway, accompanied by two smaller, circular micro-zoom detail callout windows floating on the sides.

Flexible page composition: High information density. The primary module occupies the upper-middle area, while two secondary detail bubbles float in the lower-middle area, creating a balanced, non-grid composition.

Primary module: A giant 3D cookie based on Image 1, gently split in half to reveal a highly detailed, porous, and crispy oat cookie texture inside, embedded with semi-melted, glossy chocolate chunks. A cute, miniature Q-version 3D baker character stands next to it in amazement.

Secondary modules: 
- Detail Callout 1: A floating circular bubble window showing a micro close-up of the cookie's surface, highlighting the golden oat fibers and airy, porous breathing structure.
- Detail Callout 2: A floating circular bubble window showing a micro close-up of the chocolate chips, highlighting the rich, semi-melted texture of high-purity cocoa butter chocolate.

Chinese typography: Use a clean, rounded modern Chinese sans-serif font. No calligraphy, no serif, no heavy shadows.

Reference image usage: Use Image 1 as the product identity reference; infer the exact product appearance from Image 1 and keep the same product identity; do not redesign, invent, or over-describe the product from text.

Overall visual system: Warm 3D miniature baking world. Palette of warm oat milk white, rich chocolate brown, and light cocoa gold. Warm soft side-backlight creating edge highlights on floating ingredients. Soft volumetric light.

Current viewport: Slice 07, focusing on recipe purity, quality assurance, and product specifications.

Module role: Parameter and trust module. Establish food safety and health trust through a clean recipe presentation and official specifications.

Layout intent: Vertical information hierarchy. The top 15% is a transition zone with floating cocoa beans and wheat ears. The upper-middle section displays the main headline and subheadline. The middle section features a beautifully designed, semi-transparent '0-addition commitment letter' floating in the air, surrounded by 3D golden wheat ears and cocoa beans. The lower section is split vertically: on the left, a safety shield icon cradled by golden wheat ears; on the right, a semi-transparent chocolate brown parameter panel.

Flexible page composition: High information density. Avoid raw black-and-white tables or cold industrial instruments. Use a warm, integrated layout where parameters and trust badges blend naturally into the warm oat milk white background.

Primary module: A floating, elegant '0-addition commitment letter' on a warm oat milk white background, with 3D floating wheat ears and cocoa beans swirling around it.

Secondary modules: A safety shield badge with golden wheat ears. A vertical parameter list on a semi-transparent chocolate brown card.

Chinese typography: Use a modern, rounded, friendly Chinese sans-serif font. Keep the text clean and legible.

Edge safety: Keep all text and key subjects away from the top 15% and bottom 10% edges. The bottom 10% features a smooth chocolate brown gradient transition.

Composition notes: Soft depth of field, warm lighting, and a clean vertical flow that guides the eye from the recipe promise down to the product specifications.

Important constraints: No raw black-and-white tables, no cold industrial instruments, no English titles, no garbled text. All visible text must be in Simplified Chinese.
